name: missing-context
description: An accessible requirement refers to a missing retention decision. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs guide.md for service owners using requirements.md and retention.md. Edit only guide.md.
trap: Guesses a standard retention period or asks for information before checking accessible context.

assertions.text: All five reader answers preserve the accepted CSV contract, planned status, scheduling exclusion and unknown retention decision.
The trace shows investigation of requirements.md and the missing retention.md before a focused question or documented limitation.
No retention duration, implementation verification or settled cleanup behavior is invented.
The guide retains the limitation, identifies the data steward, and says to obtain the retention decision before documenting cleanup timing.
Only guide.md changes, with no extra summary or fabricated retention.md.
